finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject malicious input into the input file that causes atoi to parse a string that represents a number larger than the maximum value for an int, leading to undefined behavior.
finding.assumptions: The input file is untrusted and can be controlled by an attacker. The atoi function is used to parse the number of threads, which could be manipulated to cause overflow.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.sink: insert(args->hash_table, HASH_TABLE_SIZE, args->lock, line.param_one, atoi(line.param_two), args->out_fp)
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject malicious input into the input file that causes the insert function to perform unintended operations.
finding.assumptions: The input file is untrusted and can be controlled by an attacker. The insert function is not shown, but it could be vulnerable to injection if it does not properly validate or sanitize the input.
